description: The ⋮ popover beside the sidebar's search: how the list is grouped (Folder, Created or Updated), and which of Baude's own groups are listed. A group is a named list of chats of Baude's own, whatever host they're on. Opened by clicking the ⋮ button.

parts.name: Group by
parts.shows: A heading "Group by" over three radio buttons: "Folder", "Created" and "Updated", the current one marked. Remembered across restarts ("date" from before is Updated). Folder is the default.

actions.does: Regroups the list: by folder (open chat's folder first, then by latest activity); by the day each chat was made (Created: Today, Yesterday, five days, Older; a chat and those under it by the day the top one was made, newest made first); or by the day each was last used (Updated: the same days, a chat and those under it by the latest activity of any of them).

parts.name: Groups
parts.shows: Under a separator, the Groups checks: the same widget as the Kubernetes page's Namespaces menu (pickers.CheckList; the phone's MenuChecks, as its Namespaces). A check over them all, worded "Groups" and drawn as a section heading (as "Group by"), checked while every group is listed (and so checked); a separator, then a check per group (Baude's own groups): "Desktop" first while there are Claude Desktop chats here or on a host, then the rest alphabetical case-insensitively, then "No group" last; then, under a separator, "New Group…". Groups known: those made with New Group…, those chats are put in, and those hosts' sessions were started in.

parts.name: Group checks
parts.shows: "Groups", as a heading with a check: checked while every group is listed. Then one square check per group with its name, checked while it's listed: every one checked while every group is listed, as at first. Which groups are listed is remembered across restarts, and a group that has gone is neither shown nor counted out.

actions.does: While every group is listed: unchecks every group, so none is listed. Otherwise: checks every group, so every one is listed (groups made later too).

Lists that group, or stops listing it; the others stay as they are. Unchecking one while every group is listed lists all the rest. Checking the last unchecked one is every group listed (Groups checked); unchecking the last checked one lists none.
Menu: "Rename Group…" and "Delete Group". The "No group" row has none.

parts.name: Group right-click menu
parts.shows: Two items at the pointer: "Rename Group…" and "Delete Group".

phone.does: Opened by a long-press on a group's row

actions.does: Opens the group-name dialog headed "Rename group" (GroupName.dialog.json); its chats move to the new name (to a group already there, they join it); the group stays listed if it was.
The group is deleted at once, its chats put in no group; a toast "Group “<name>” deleted" with an Undo button (5 seconds) restores the group, its chats and what was listed.

parts.name: New Group…
parts.shows: A menu item "New Group…" under the list.

actions.does: Opens the group-name dialog "New group" (GroupName.dialog.json); the group is made, listed even if empty, no chat moved.

decisions.said: Claude Desktop's chats go into a Desktop group automatically, kept apart from the rest
decisions.rule: Every app lists Desktop first among the groups while there are Claude Desktop chats, and gives it no Rename Group… or Delete Group: its chats are in it because of what they are.

parts.name: Group view of the open chat (open_group)
parts.shows: Not a screen: the group of the open chat is its put-in group, else (for a host's session) the group it was started in unless that is only its host's own, else none; a new chat not written in yet has the group it was started in. The open chat that's not saved yet is listed only if its group is listed; a new chat's group (see Sidebar.region.json, New session's group rule) is ticked in the menu too if it wasn't.

states.name: none listed
states.shows: "Groups" unchecked, every group unchecked; the list has no group's chats.

states.name: no groups at all
states.shows: "Groups" checked, and just "No group" under it, checked.

decisions.said: the groups in that menu get square checkboxes, the same as the one in Namespaces
decisions.rule: The group list is the Namespaces picker on every app: a square checkbox per group and one over them all that lists every group again, never ticks, radio dots or a Show All row.

decisions.said: Ehh groups should still look a bit like a header....
decisions.rule: The check over all the groups is worded "Groups" and drawn as a section heading (like "Group by": small, bold, dim) while keeping its checkbox and behaviour. Kubernetes' "All namespaces" row stays an ordinary row.

decisions.said: With every group selected, every group's checkbox should be ticked; clicking Groups while all are selected should select none (paraphrased)
decisions.rule: On every app a check over a list of checks (⋮ → Groups, Kubernetes' Namespaces) is a select-all: every item checked while every one is shown, the one over them checked only then; clicking it while it's checked unchecks every item (none shown), otherwise checks every item; clicking an item toggles that item alone. Never "every item shown" drawn as every item unchecked.

decisions.said: Group by should offer Folder, Created and Updated
decisions.rule: Group by has exactly Folder, Created (the day each chat was made, from its transcript's first record) and Updated (the day it was last used) on every app; arrowing through the choices only moves focus and never changes the grouping.
